name: Castle Creampuff
detailed_description:
Castle Creampuff is an explicit 2D visual novel with life‑sim, RPG‑style combat, and erotic content, set in a vibrant medieval village.

After your father’s death, the protagonist remains in the family home, now shared with a maid and a lodger. But who are they to him—step‑mother and adopted sister, or simply unrelated women?
At the start of the game, you can choose the nature of your relationship with them to tailor the story to your preferences.

The village is home to many alluring women—from the local witch and mysterious trader to a senior mentor and exotic travelers. You can build individual relationships with each heroine and unlock unique erotic scenes.

Gameplay

Castle Creampuff combines visual‑novel mechanics, everyday life simulation, and light RPG combat.

Main loop:

Each day, you choose who to talk to, which locations to visit, and how to spend your time. Bonding with heroines develops through dialogue, tasks, and gifts. New scenes and fetishes unlock as relationships grow.

Combat system:

The game features simple but functional combat, based on melee and ranged weapons: sword, bow, and sling. Battles occur in certain quests and may affect access to new areas or rewards.

Earning and economy:

There are multiple ways to earn money: completing tasks, scavenging, fighting, and more. Coins earned can be spent on gifts for the girls or special items for yourself.

Features:

  • 16 female characters, each with a unique visual and erotic arc

    Medieval fantasy aesthetic: castles, forests, taverns, hidden paths

    Gallery for replaying unlocked scenes

    Variety of fetishes, including:

    Hand‑drawn 2D animation and art

    Regular updates with new content, locations, and mechanics

⚠ Important

Castle Creampuff is intended for an adult audience (18+).
The game includes explicit sexual scenes, elements of violence, and mentions of drugs and alcohol.

All characters are portrayed as adults (18+), and all sexual interactions are consensual.
Some storylines include step‑family elements—the degree of kinship can be selected at the beginning of the game.

Characters:

Nicole

A woman who has lived with you for a long time. Lately she feels melancholy. There's sometimes... tension between you.

Emmie

The girl you’ve known since childhood. Always around, loves to talk and asks very frank questions.

Fatima

A neighbor. She’s shy but often calls you for help—especially when she’s home alone.

Katy

A barmaid. She always smiles and hints at “bonuses” for her favorite customers.

Vivienne

She lives alone in the woods. Strange, mocking, she loves brewing potions…and experimenting on you. With her, you never know how it will end.

Even more characters in the game...
